experiments.title: Compare launch speeds
experiments.instruction: Predict what happens at 0.60× baseline speed. Keep central mass at 1×. Choose a prediction, then Test 0.60× speed.
experiments.observe: The path reaches the planet. Explain how insufficient sideways motion lets gravity curve the path into the surface.

experiments.title: Test escape
experiments.instruction: Predict what 1.42× speed will do. Choose 1.42× speed, keeping central mass at 1×, then use Play motion or Trace position.
experiments.observe: Compare with 1.00× speed. The escaping probe still experiences gravity; explain why escape does not mean gravity disappears.
